identity.name: Glacier Diagram
identity.summary: A square blue slate showing a stepped white mountain.
identity.description: Costs 3 mana per activation. Deals 9 magical damage per affordable activation. Reduces each enemy strike this round by 3.
identity.lore: The lines advance a hair each winter.
